contracts.legacyLoads: R11 frozen 20-contract token masses; peak metrics are max of per-track group sums; weighted home uses ensembleV5 track weights.
contracts.nativeLoads: Actual selected terminal codes, including auxiliary keys; frequency-weighted within each mode/word length. Composite averages normalized track loads with character:word2:word3:word4=1:3:1:1 and keytao:sanpin=1:1; no selection-key or inter-code boundary strokes.
contracts.rawCollisions: Frequency-weighted homocode affected rate and first-choice loss in each isolated main-code track: character=2, word2=4, word3=4 (AAAU), word4=4. Rows are dictionary readings, as in CKT; identical readings are deduplicated by the existing corpus builder.
contracts.actualRouting: Characters compete separately; word2/word3/word4 compete jointly under soft page balancing. First-main loss is final code longer than first stage; word3 first stage=AAA. Needs-aux means terminal length>baseLength (4 for word3).
